name: Furubira (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Furubira town emblem in blue: a ring open at the top with a V-shaped device above, forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Furubira, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 May 1968.

features.role: Furubira town emblem — a ring open at the top with a V-shaped device above, forming a stylised character
